instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct cause conjunction from the list.

atoms.b: Clara was in trouble ((because)) she hadn’t done her homework.

atoms.b: We won the competition and got a shiny trophy ((as_a_result)).
Tahir had exams soon and was ((thus)) stressed.
Cordelia was hungry and ate all her dinner ((accordingly)).

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct cause preposition from the list.

Thomas was happy ((as_a_result)) of his new wife.
